identity.name: RentKr
identity.theme_strategy: Swiss Red - High Contrast, Bold Typography, Minimalist

primary.name: RentKr Red
primary.description: Use for primary CTAs, active states, and brand highlights. Do not overuse.

secondary.name: Slate Dark
secondary.description: Use for headings, dark mode backgrounds, and strong contrast elements.

accent.name: AI Teal
accent.description: Use sparingly for AI-related features (Match Score, Verified Badge) to contrast with Red.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border border-white/20 shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.gradients: bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-500 to-rose-700 (Use only for primary buttons/icons, NEVER full screen)

landing_page.hero: Split screen or Centered with large search bar. Use 'Hero Image' as background with overlay or side-by-side.
landing_page.features: Bento Grid (Mode A). Mix large spans for key features (AI Match) and small spans for stats.
landing_page.trust_section: Marquee of trust badges (No Brokerage, Verified).

dashboard.grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). Sidebar navigation. Cards for stats.
dashboard.cards: Flat, bordered cards. No heavy shadows. Header with actions.

buttons.primary: bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-rose-600/20 transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all

cards.property: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 hover:border-rose-200 dark:hover:border-rose-900 transition-all duration-300
cards.feature: p-8 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-900 transition-colors

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/20 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950

badges.verified: bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border border-teal-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1
badges.ai_match: bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons for all UI elements. Use 'Sparkles' for AI, 'ShieldCheck' for verified, 'Home' for dashboard, 'Search' for search bars.

variants.fadeIn: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
variants.staggerContainer: initial='hidden' animate='show' variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0 }, show: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1 } } }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on Red buttons is White. Ensure text on light backgrounds is Slate-900.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have aria-labels if no text is present.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: `npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the 'rose' color palette as 'primary' and add 'Manrope' font family.
3. CREATE COMPONENTS: Build `Button`, `Card`, `Input` using the styles defined above. Do not use default Shadcn styles without customization.
4. LANDING PAGE: Build a 'Hero' section with the `hero_bg` image, a 'Search' component floating over it, and a 'Features' section using the Bento Grid.
5. DASHBOARD: Create a sidebar layout. Use the 'High Density Grid' for the dashboard content.
6. AI FEATURES: Implement the 'AI Match Score' visual using a circular progress indicator (use SVG or a library like `recharts` pie chart).
7. THEME: Default to Light Mode, but ensure Dark Mode support is robust (slate-950 backgrounds).
8. DATA-TESTID: Add `data-testid` to all buttons, inputs, and links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8, p-12).
Micro-animations are mandatory for every interaction.
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/headers without blur.
